# WalshIntegral

Source API 0.10.0. Public repository interface:
https://github.com/chenle02/walsh-integral-lean

Added in 0.8.0 (verified at 35bc9935bea9): mean zero of the Walsh integral and of
the totalized integral; predictable fields have F t-measurable time sections
and an adapted representative. Every 0.7.0 statement is unchanged.

Added in 0.10.0 (verified at fbe62e483ae1): the real-p moment constant is linear,
bdgConst p = p - 1 (bdgConst_eq), from Gaussian integration by parts
(GaussianStein) and the Gaussian slab step (GaussianStep). Every earlier
statement keeps its form; 152 inventoried public theorems.

Read the exact Lean statement before using a result. The source declaration
determines every hypothesis and quantifier; each receipt covers only its named
scientific content. A version number alone does not establish verification.
